name: kathachepta
description: KathaChepta: human-narrated stories and audiobooks for families

scripts.users:demo: docker compose exec api python -m app.cli seed-demo
scripts.migrate:legacy: docker compose exec api python -m app.migrate_sqlite
scripts.app:web: cd app && npx expo export -p web
scripts.app:test: cd app && npx tsc --noEmit && npx expo lint && node --test src/lib/player/logic.test.ts src/lib/i18n.test.ts
scripts.app:apk: cd app && npx eas-cli@latest build --platform android --profile preview
